policy.activation_rule: A binding is promotable only when WS21 source authority, WS02 likelihood consistency and the required WS01 physics axis are terminal and receipt-backed.

bindings.mechanism: FLRW background expansion H(z; theta) from the selected canonical background physics contract
bindings.mathematical_map: theta -> H_model(z) -> residual H_obs-H_model using the frozen pure-CC selection
bindings.selection: source begins with CC_ and excludes labels containing BAO
bindings.falsifier: selected H(z) surface, units, null limit or integration tolerance disagrees with the frozen canonical contract

bindings.mechanism: background distances and drag-epoch sound horizon under the selected canonical background physics contract
bindings.mathematical_map: theta -> {D_M(z)/r_d, D_H(z)/r_d, D_V(z)/r_d} -> 13-vector residual under frozen covariance
bindings.falsifier: r_d semantics, data order, covariance or null-limit behavior differs from the frozen canonical contract

bindings.mechanism: background luminosity distance mapped to SN magnitude residuals with shared nuisance treatment
bindings.mathematical_map: theta -> D_L(z) -> distance modulus/m_B model -> residual with analytically profiled M_B
bindings.falsifier: distance map, covariance selection or nuisance treatment differs between competitors or from the frozen contract
